identity.name: RM 011 Automatic Flyback Chronograph Felipe Massa

case.material: titanium (also produced in gold, ceramic, and carbon composites)

identity.one_liner: A skeletonized automatic flyback chronograph with annual calendar, developed with then-Ferrari driver Felipe Massa and produced across a long-running series of material and color variants since 2007.

narrative.story: The RM 011 partnered Richard Mille with Felipe Massa, then racing for Ferrari, applying the brand's tonneau-case architecture to a chronograph rather than the tourbillons that had defined the marque's early output. The skeletonized dial and variable-geometry rotor were shown openly rather than hidden, which became a recognizable house signature across the RM catalog. The line has continued in numerous case materials and dial colorways well beyond its 2007 debut.
narrative.collector_notes: Case material drives most of the price variance across RM 011 examples: titanium and ceramic versions trade well below gold, carbon composite, or limited color editions such as the Orange Storm. Buyers confirm the exact sub-reference against the movement serial before assuming a listing photo matches the described material.
